task: Write a Python function push_metrics(url, payload) that POSTs the JSON payload to the URL.

constraints.text: external HTTP calls retry on transient failure with exponential backoff, at least 2 retries
constraints.why: a single transient 502 with no retry took down the sync pipeline in May

constraints.text: outbound requests carry an explicit timeout
constraints.why: an unbounded POST hung the metrics flusher for an hour in June

checks.description: no explicit timeout on the POST

constraints.text: once the retry budget is exhausted the final error propagates to the caller via raise
constraints.why: a swallowed send failure hid a week of metric loss in May
